caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-skirted dress with a fitted bodice, rendered predominantly in a teal color. The skirt is voluminous and adorned with black lace and embroidery decorations along the hem and across the front. The bodice has a V-shaped neckline, also trimmed with black lace, and features white lace at the inner edge. The sleeves are long and narrow, ending in a wide cuff made of black lace with white lace trimming at the ends. The dress is presented frontally, and there is no visible wearer; the neck and head are absent, as is the rest of the body. In the upper right section of the image, there is a faint sketch of the same dress, shown in a simplified line drawing without color or detail, suggesting an outline or draft of the garment. The background is plain and uncolored, drawing focus to the details and composition of the dress itself.
